scope: Read-only comparison of current-main generated image maps with public files and the historical native asset selection

nativeSelection.status: Historical native selection is intentionally unchanged; a controlled refresh is required before a fresh current-main native candidate can claim coverage of generated optimized media.

conclusion: All generated current-main optimized references resolve to files in the public tree. The native bundle selection does not include those optimized files, so current-main native asset coverage is an open packaging decision; no missing-file claim or silent selection expansion is made.
